mapper.sql: id, biz_type, biz_id, idempotency_key, money_affecting, state, HEX(owner_token) owner_token_hex, fence_token, lease_until, attempt_count, max_attempts, next_attempt_at, last_error_code
mapper.insert: insert ignore into wx_payment_callback_outbox (biz_type, biz_id, idempotency_key, money_affecting, state, fence_token, attempt_count, max_attempts, create_time, update_time) values (#{bizType}, #{bizId}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{moneyAffecting}, #{state}, 0, 0, #{maxAttempts}, NOW(3), NOW(3))
mapper.select: select from wx_payment_callback_outbox where state in (0, 3) and money_affecting = 0 and (next_attempt_at is null or next_attempt_at <= NOW(3)) order by next_attempt_at asc, id asc limit #{limit} for update
mapper.update: update wx_payment_callback_outbox set state = 1, owner_token = UNHEX(#{ownerToken}), fence_token = fence_token + 1, attempt_count = attempt_count + 1, lease_until = DATE_ADD(NOW(3), INTERVAL 120 SECOND), next_attempt_at = null, update_time = NOW(3) where id = #{id} and state in (0, 3) and money_affecting = 0

update wx_payment_callback_outbox set state = 2, lease_until = null, next_attempt_at = null, last_error_code = null, update_time = NOW(3) where id = #{id} and state = 1 and owner_token = UNHEX(#{ownerToken}) and fence_token = #{fenceToken}

update wx_payment_callback_outbox set state = case when attempt_count >= max_attempts then 4 else 3 end, next_attempt_at = case when attempt_count >= max_attempts then null else DATE_ADD(NOW(3), INTERVAL (60 * attempt_count) SECOND) end, last_error_code = #{errorCode}, lease_until = null, update_time = NOW(3) where id = #{id} and state = 1 and owner_token = UNHEX(#{ownerToken}) and fence_token = #{fenceToken} and money_affecting = 0

update wx_payment_callback_outbox set state = 4, next_attempt_at = null, last_error_code = #{errorCode}, lease_until = null, update_time = NOW(3) where id = #{id} and state = 1 and owner_token = UNHEX(#{ownerToken}) and fence_token = #{fenceToken}
